title: Stable convergence of partial sum processes towards discontinuous limits
summary: We develop a stable convergence theorem for partial sum processes on sample-size dependent stochastic bases. The result allows multidimensional semimartingale limits that have conditionally independent increments and both a continuous and discontinuous martingale part. Motivated by infill asymptotics, it complements classical Gaussian stable limit theorems and supports applications to likelihood based statistical inference.
